column5: ResNet-9/DavidNet + time-based one-cycle, bf16+channels_last, Cutout+label-smoothing, batch 512
column6: Replacing ResNet-20+MultiStepLR with DavidNet under a budget-completing one-cycle yields +3.65pp (91.57->95.22) within 300s.

column5: Weight EMA(0.998, use_buffers) eval'd each epoch + flip-TTA gated to final 20%, on the EXP-001 DavidNet recipe (otherwise unchanged)
column6: Evaluating a short-horizon weight EMA plus tail-only flip-TTA adds +0.50pp (95.22->95.72) for ~free, orthogonal to the training recipe.

column5: Frozen 3x3 ZCA patch-whitening first conv (off-budget eigendecomp, excluded from optimizer) prepended to the EXP-002 DavidNet+EMA+TTA recipe
column6: A frozen patch-whitening front-end adds +0.15pp (95.72->95.87) by speeding early convergence; gain persists despite ~9 fewer epochs from the per-step overhead.

column5: ReZero-gated Residual(256) block added to layer2 (identity-init via learnable alpha=0) on the EXP-003 whiten+EMA+TTA recipe; PEAK_LR held at 0.4
column6: Adding one identity-init (ReZero) residual block to layer2 lifts best_test_acc +0.13pp (95.87->96.00); capacity gain outran the 32-epoch throughput cost.

column5: Second ReZero-gated Residual(512) block appended to layer3 (4x4) on the EXP-004 recipe; PEAK_LR held at 0.4
column6: A 2nd ReZero block at layer3/4x4 gives -0.10pp (96.00->95.90): coarse 4x4 capacity unused AND the block ran slower (23.4k vs 26.1k img/s), costing 11 epochs.

column5: Multi-crop translation TTA (airbench96 tta_level=2, 6 views) replacing mirror-only TTA; eval-only, training byte-identical to EXP-004
column6: Multi-crop TTA works (visible +0.28pp onset step) but its translate-over-mirror increment is swamped by ~0.1pp run-to-run variance from time-budgeted epoch-count jitter (142->150).

column5: Widen layer2 8x8 stage 256->384 (capacity via width, +2.2M params); all else byte-identical to EXP-004
column6: Widening layer2 256->384 under-annealed: it cut epochs 150->94 (still climbing at budget end), so capacity could not be realized in 300s; try a milder 256->320.

column5: Stronger augmentation: Cutout 8->12 + light RandomErasing(p=0.25,scale=0.02-0.15,value=0); all else byte-identical to EXP-004
column6: Throughput-free stronger augmentation (cutout12 + RandomErasing) spends the epoch surplus: +0.38pp (96.00->96.38), num_epochs 150 unchanged, clean attribution.

column5: Muon (Newton-Schulz orthogonalized momentum, ns=3, airbench weight-renorm replacing L2) on conv weights @ peak LR 0.24; fc/BN/alpha on unchanged EXP-008 SGD; else byte-identical to EXP-008
column6: Muon peak LR 0.24 too high: net diverged to ~random through the high-LR phase (ep25-100 ~10-20%), re-learned only in the anneal tail to 94.11; lower PEAK_LR_MUON (~0.1) next.

column5: Sweep PEAK_LR_MUON {0.03,0.06,0.10,0.14} for the Muon conv optimizer (EXP-009 follow-up); winner 0.03 confirmed at full throughput; fc/BN/alpha on unchanged SGD.
column6: Tuned Muon (best LR 0.03) only MATCHES tuned SGD-Nesterov (96.33 vs 96.38, within noise) — orthogonalized optimizer fixes the divergence but reaches no better minimum on this net/budget.

column5: CutMix region-mixing aug (alpha=1, p=0.5, tail-off 0.85) on EXP-008 recipe; 2 cells LS 0.2/0.1. Best 96.40 (LS0.2, +0.02pp); LS0.1 96.32. Within noise.
column6: CutMix only matches baseline (96.40 vs 96.38) on this saturated strong-aug net: depresses early convergence (ep25 -1.1pp), annealed ceiling unchanged by LS — redundant with occlusion aug.

column5: Weight-decay shaping (no-decay on BN gamma/beta + ReZero alpha) + LS retune; 4-cell same-session. Headline shaping cA 96.29 vs same-session c0 96.32; LS0.1 worse (cB 96.16, cC 96.09). None >=96.48.
column6: WD-shaping ties baseline (96.29 vs same-session 96.32) despite halving |ReZero alpha|; the capacity gate is not accuracy-limiting and LS0.1 degrades, so SGD regularization scalars are tuned.

column5: Tail-only SAM rho=0.05 in low-LR tail; cells c0/cA(start0.65)/cB(start0.75). Best SAM cA 96.29@124ep vs same-session c0 96.47; cB 96.18@132ep. None >=96.48.
column6: Tail-only SAM loses (96.29 vs same-session 96.47): its 2x-cost epoch loss (150->124) outweighs any flat-minima gain at 300s; even the annealed lighter cell cB 96.18 is below baseline.

column5: torch.compile off-budget warmup for throughput; cells c0/cA(compile)/cB(compile+layer2-320). Run1 GPU-contended(discarded); clean Run2: c0 96.29@154ep, cA 96.32@173ep, cB 96.21@143ep; none>=96.48.
column6: torch.compile cleanly buys +12% epochs (154->173) but accuracy ties (cA +0.03); compile-funded 320 anneals at 143ep yet loses -0.08 -> net is anneal+capacity saturated, not epoch-bound.

column5: Mild RandAugment(N1,M6) policy aug; same-session c0/cA(replace RandomErasing)/cB(add on top). c0 96.36, cA 96.34, cB 96.36 all @149ep; none>=96.48. ep25 normal, fully annealed.
column6: Mild RandAugment ties baseline both as replacement (96.34) and addition (96.36=c0) at matched 149ep, ep25 normal (not under-fit); input-aug saturated across occlusion/mixing/transform.

column5: GhostBN regularizing BN-stat noise; layer-restricted to fit throughput
column6: Layer3-only GhostBN beat same-session control +0.24pp (96.38 vs 96.14) at 16 fewer epochs but missed 96.48 bar; ghosting breaks fused BN kernel (~50% slower all-site)->under-anneal.

column5: Throughput-free BN-affine noise (NoisyBN, cheap GhostBN surrogate) at calibrated layer3 sigma; same-session c0/cA(sigma=0.033)/cB(sigma=0.083)
column6: Calibrated ghost-equivalent BN noise (cA sigma=0.033) tied control exactly (96.14=96.14) at near-full epochs; EXP-016's +0.24 was a low-c0-draw artifact, BN-noise axis closed.

column5: BlurPool anti-aliased downsampling (Zhang 2019) at layer1/2/3; same-session c0/cA(blur ks3)/cB(blur ks5). Faithful MaxBlurPool throughput-disqualified (132ep), tested throughput-free BlurPool-only.
column6: Anti-aliased blur-subsampling lost to MaxPool control (cA -0.08, cB -0.15, monotonically worse with blur); no shift-equivariance headroom on this strongly-augmented 32x32 net.

column5: SE channel attention identity-init 2*sigmoid gate; same-session c0/cA(layer2+3)/cB(all-3) + confirmation pair. cA 96.39/144ep vs c0 96.11; cB 96.21/139ep. Confirm: cAb 96.31 vs c0b 96.29.
column6: SE (layer2+3) ties control: s1 +0.28pp did NOT replicate (+0.02pp confirm), cA never >=96.48; channel attention redundant on saturated 7.8M net; adding layer1 SE net-negative.

column5: Cosine one-cycle LR decay (vs linear triangular); SCHEDULE=cos branch, PCT_START=0.15, throughput-free
column6: Cosine ties control: s1 cos +0.32pp (low-control-draw artifact, c0 96.04) did NOT replicate (confirm +0.04pp, c0b 96.35); 96.39<96.48 floor.

column5: Compile-funded DEPTH: +1 ReZero GatedResidual(256) at 8x8 layer2 (+1.18M), torch.compile funds the per-step cost (152 ep)
column6: Depth at the proven 8x8 stage TIES control at full anneal (cA 96.26 @152ep vs c0 96.29 @173ep, -0.03pp); within-DavidNet width AND depth now both exhausted.

column5: Wholesale backbone swap to budget pre-act Wide ResNet (cA WRN-22-4 96.31@133ep, cB WRN-16-4 96.34@196ep) vs same-session compiled DavidNet c0 96.32@172ep; compile-funded, identical recipe
column6: A pre-act Wide ResNet backbone TIES DavidNet at full anneal across 2 sizes (96.31/96.34 vs 96.32); the ~96.4 ceiling is backbone-family-independent, not DavidNet-specific.
